subject: [AMBER] Comparison of TIP3P vs AMOEBA water models

messages.author: Umesh Roy
messages.body:
Dear Users,
Has anyone done a comparative study of the structure of water between
TIP3P and AMOEBA water models, (for pure water case or the hydration
behavior around any solutes such as polar, non-polar, or bio-molecules?
If yes, please let me know the references. Thank you.
Thank you
Umesh
